claim_boundary: NIST defines the Conover squared-rank scale statistic and warns that its published small-sample critical route is approximate. Schweikert and CME support a state-dependent gold/silver relative-value carrier and opposed-leg form, including adverse evidence. The fixed monthly XAU/XAG sample, strict deviation tie rejection, complete 924 fixed-score label enumeration, 461-tail activity boundary, raw-mean contrarian side, CFD mapping, aggregate risk, atomicity, and lifecycle are pre-result QuantMechanica choices. The exhaustive label count is an activity gate, not a source p-value or published critical value. No return, frequency, neutrality, decorrelation, or profitability claim transfers.
